title: A tidier model catalog
summary:
The model catalog got easier to browse, and the Creative Projects list gained a celebrity image generator.

`GET /models` no longer returns pricing fields. It lists non-community models first, then community models, alphabetically within each group. The catalog also assigns `openai-fast` (GPT-4.1 Nano) to the anonymous tier and refreshes OpenAI model descriptions and provider labels. Text-generation telemetry now retains complete usage data, including cached-token counts.

The Creative Projects list now includes @Colin-Zero’s Celebrity AI Image Generator, which uses Pollinations.ai and a1.art to make celebrity images from text or selfies from uploaded photos.

highlights.title: GPT-4.1 Nano in anonymous tier
highlights.text: The model catalog now assigns `openai-fast` (GPT-4.1 Nano) to the anonymous tier. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-fast).
